svg.title: BOKI character modeling handoff
svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC
Blender shape reference + editable construction notes / Unity 6000.6.7f1 target
Lectern 1.10 m high; floor ring scales
M_Lectern: rigid base, stem and slanted reading
FX_DeadlineRing: separate flat annulus, not boss
Three independently spawned paper projectiles per
Guilt wall shadow: decorative, separate from
Lectern root on floor center; avoid hidden
Use a real annulus mesh or flat quad material for
Raise the ring a small tested offset to avoid
Keep the arena center free; desks and lectern must
Attack art does not define radius or damage
Exam Barrage: visual release, exactly 3 slow
Deadline Slam: 0.8 s warning then area hit
At 50% HP: short glitch and slightly faster
FERI B: 2 melee adds once at half HP.
FERI C + POWER OFF: boss begins at 85% HP.
FX ring placement uses an arena floor transform.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
